settings.heading: Why home cooks actually use it

settings.title: Locked-in angle
settings.text: The magnetic block holds your blade at exactly 15° or 20°. No wobble, no guesswork, no "am I doing this right?"

settings.title: About a minute
settings.text: 20 rolls a side on diamond, 10 on ceramic. Done before the pasta water boils.

settings.title: Diamond + ceramic
settings.text: The diamond disc sets the edge. The ceramic disc polishes it smooth.

settings.title: Made for gifting
settings.text: Solid wood, a satisfying magnet, and a gift-ready box. It looks like more than it costs.

settings.title: Stick
settings.text: Set your knife on the magnetic block. Use the 15° side for thin Japanese-style knives and 20° for Western knives.

settings.title: Roll
settings.text: Roll the diamond disc along the edge about 20 times. Flip the knife over and repeat.

settings.title: Polish & slice
settings.text: Switch to the ceramic disc for about 10 rolls per side. Then slice a tomato and enjoy it.

settings.question: Will it work on my knives?
settings.answer: It works on most straight-edged (non-serrated) steel kitchen, chef, santoku, paring, and pocket knives. It's not for serrated bread knives, scissors, ceramic knives, or single-bevel Japanese knives (yanagiba, deba).

settings.question: 15° or 20°: which side do I use?
settings.answer: 15° for thin Japanese-style knives (santoku, gyuto). 20° for most Western/German-style chef knives. Not sure? Start with 20°.

settings.question: Will it damage my good knives?
settings.answer: A fixed angle means you sharpen the edge you already have instead of grinding a new one. Start with fewer rolls (10–20 per side) and check the edge. You can always do more. Pull-through sharpeners work differently: they scrape the edge through a fixed V-slot.

settings.question: How often should I use it?
settings.answer: Use the ceramic side for a quick touch-up every week or two. Use the diamond side when the knife starts squashing tomatoes, typically every 1–3 months for home cooks.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed in 1–3 business days. US delivery then takes about 7–12 business days, so plan on 8–15 business days total. You'll get a tracking number by email. Full details are on our shipping policy.

settings.question: Is it a good gift? Can I hide the price?
settings.answer: Yes. It arrives in a gift-ready box, and we never put prices in the package. Add a gift note at checkout.

settings.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: You have 60 days from delivery. If it doesn't sharpen your knives, email us for a full refund. See our refund policy.

settings.question: Is it safe to use?
settings.answer: The magnet holds the blade steady, so your hands stay on the roller, away from the edge. Always keep fingers clear of the blade, cut away from your body, and store it out of reach of children.

settings.question: Where is it made?
settings.answer: Keenroll is designed for home cooks and made by our manufacturing partner in China. We check samples from every supplier batch before selling them.
